steps.note: A `$ref` to the vocabulary inside the house schema is a compile failure, exit 2, when the first page it governs is validated.
Three pages, three outcomes: the page with no citation fails under your schema.
The page with a malformed entry fails under the vocabulary. Same `meta validate docs/reference/` run.
At its default, `claim-changed` is a warning, reported and green.
With `claim-changed: error` the same run blocks the branch.
A duplicate id is `entry-invalid` at check time, on the second entry's line.

scaffolding: schema/reference-page.schema.json is the page's house schema; schema/citations-1.0.0-proposal.4.json is the vocabulary already copied in, as the page says to.

manni.config.yaml declares the `reference` collection (docs/reference/**/*.md) and the meta override with both schemas as a set; it has no `cite:` section, so a spec adds the page's `severity:` block before the blocking run.

docs/reference/ holds entry-invalid.md (an entry missing source integrity, plus duplicate ids), limits.md (a pinned sentence since edited, so claim-changed), and retries.md (no citations); lib/limits.ts is the cited source.
